1.text: Muri icyo gihe hari abantu bari bahari bamutekerereza iby'Abanyagalilaya, abo Pilato yavangiye amaraso yabo n'ibitambo byabo.

2.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Mbese mugira ngo abo Banyagalilaya bari abanyabyaha kuruta abandi Banyagalilaya, ubwo bababajwe batyo?

3.text: Ndababwira yuko atari ko biri, ahubwo namwe nimutihana muzarimbuka mutyo mwese.

4.text: Cyangwa se ba bandi cumi n'umunani, abo umunara w'i Silowamu wagwiriye ukabica, mugira ngo bari abanyabyaha kuruta abandi b'i Yerusalemu bose?

5.text: Ndababwira yuko atari ko biri, ahubwo namwe nimutihana muzarimbuka mutyo mwese.”

6.text: Kandi abacira uyu mugani ati “Hāriho umuntu wateye umutini mu ruzabibu rwe, bukeye araza awushakaho imbuto arazibura.

7.text: Abwira umuhinzi ati ‘Dore none uyu mwaka ni uwa gatatu, nza gushaka imbuto kuri uyu mutini sinzibone. Uwuce, urakomeza kunyunyuriza iki ubutaka?’

8.text: Na we aramusubiza ati ‘Databuja, uwureke uyu mwaka na wo, nywuhingire nywufumbire,

9.text: ahari hanyuma wakwera imbuto. Icyakora nutera uzawuce.’ ”

10.text: Nuko ku munsi w'isabato yigishiriza mu isinagogi.

11.text: Asangamo umugore ufite dayimoni utera ubumuga, uwo mugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n'umunani ahetamye, atabasha kunamuka na hato.

12.text: Yesu amubonye aramuhamagara aramubwira ati “Mugore, ubohowe ubumuga bwawe.”

13.text: Amurambikaho ibiganza, muri ako kanya aragororoka ahagarara yemye, ahimbaza Imana.

14.text: Ariko umutware w'isinagogi arakazwa n'uko Yesu akijije umuntu ku isabato, abwira abantu ati “Hariho iminsi itandatu ikwiriye gukorerwamo imirimo, abe ari yo muzamo mukizwe hatari ku munsi w'isabato.”

15.text: Umwami Yesu aramusubiza ati “Mwa ndyarya mwe, mbese umuntu wese muri mwe ntazitura inka ye cyangwa indogobe ye, ayikura mu kiraro ku isabato, akayijyana akayuhira?

16.text: Kandi uyu ko ari umukobwa wa Aburahamu, akaba amaze iyi myaka cumi n'umunani aboshywe na Satani, ntiyari akwiye kubohorwa iyi ngoyi ku munsi w'isabato?”

17.text: Amaze kuvuga atyo abanzi be bose baramwara, abahateraniye bose bishimira imirimo myiza itangaza yose yakoze.

18.text: Nuko arabaza ati “Mbese ubwami bw'Imana bwagereranywa n'iki, cyangwa nabushushanya n'iki?

19.text: Dore bugereranywa n'akabuto ka sinapi, umuntu yenze akakabiba mu murima we, kagakura kakaba igiti maze inyoni zo mu kirere zikarika ibyari mu mashami yacyo.”

20.text: Yongera kuvuga ati “Ubwami bw'Imana ndabugereranya n'iki?

21.text: Busa n'umusemburo umugore yenze akawuhisha mu myariko itatu y'ifu, kugeza aho yose iri butubukire.”

22.text: Ajya mu midugudu n'ibirorero yigisha, ari mu nzira ajya i Yerusalemu,

23.text: umuntu aramubaza ati “Databuja, mbese abakizwa ni bake?”Na we aramusubiza ati

24.text: “Mugire umwete wo kunyura mu irembo rifunganye. Ndababwira yuko benshi bazashaka kurinyuramo ntibabibashe.

25.text: Nyir'inzu namara guhaguruka agakinga urugi, namwe mugatangira kurukomangaho muhagaze hanze muvuga muti ‘Mwami, dukingurire’, azabasubiza ati ‘Simbazi, sinzi n'aho muturutse.’

26.text: Ni bwo muzavuga muti ‘Kandi twarīraga imbere yawe, tukanywera imbere yawe, ndetse ukīgishiriza mu nzira z'iwacu!’

27.text: Ariko azababwira ati ‘Sinzi aho muturutse. Nimumve imbere mwa nkozi z'ibibi mwe!’

28.text: Aho ni ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo, mubonye Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo n'abahanuzi bose bibereye mu bwami bw'Imana, namwe mukaba mujugunywe hanze.

29.text: Hazaza abava iburasirazuba n'iburengerazuba, n'ikasikazi n'ikusi, bicare basangirire mu bwami bw'Imana.

30.text: Kandi rero, hariho ab'inyuma bamwe bazaba ab'imbere, n'ab'imbere bamwe bazaba ab'inyuma.”

31.text: Uwo munsi haza Abafarisayo bamwe baramubwira bati “Va hano, ugende kuko Herode ashaka kukwica.”

32.text: Arababwira ati “Nimugende mubwire iyo ngunzu muti ‘Dore arirukana abadayimoni, arakiza abantu none n'ejo, maze ku munsi wa gatatu azaba arangije rwose.’

33.text: Ariko nkwiriye kugenda none n'ejo n'ejo bundi, kuko bidashoboka ko umuhanuzi yicwa atari i Yerusalemu.

34.text: “Ayii! Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu we, wica abahanuzi ugatera amabuye abagutumweho! Ni kangahe nashatse kubundikira abana bawe, nk'uko inkoko ibundikira imishwi yayo mu mababa yayo ntimunkundire?

35.text: Dore inzu yanyu muyisigiwe ari umusaka, kandi ndababwira yuko mutazambona kugeza ubwo muzavuga muti ‘Hahirwa uje mu izina ry'Uwiteka.’ ”
